The '''Besero system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Besero/Legends|Besero]].
